jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken

We zoeken developers die al op seniorniveau werken: mensen die grotere systemen overzien, complexiteit beheersbaar maken en rust brengen in technische keuzes.

Samen met een team van DevOps engineers en domeinexperts bouw je aan oplossingen die direct impact hebben op de operatie van NS.

Dit ga je doen als Senior Developer

Als Senior Developer binnen het Real Time Monitoring (RTM) team
werk je aan de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe applicatie die realtime data uit de treinenvloot en haar omgeving verwerkt. Je werkt in een DevOps-team waar ontwikkeling, beheer en verbetering samenkomen. Naast het bouwen van software draag je actief bij aan technische keuzes, architectuur, de verdere ontwikkeling van het platform en de begeleiding en coaching van DevOps engineers.

Meewerken aan een event-driven en schaalbare cloudarchitectuur
Ontwerpen en implementeren van datastromen en integraties tussen treinen, platformen en applicaties
Automatiseren van deployments en bijdragen aan CI/CD pipelines
Verbeteren van performance, betrouwbaarheid en observability van applicaties en datastromen
Monitoren van systemen en ondersteunen bij het oplossen van incidenten
Integreren van de backend naar de frontend.
Samenwerken met developers, data engineers en domeinexperts binnen NS
Bijdragen aan codekwaliteit, architectuurkeuzes en technische standaarden binnen het team
Ondersteunen bij het moderniseren en vervangen van bestaande monitoringsoftware

Bij deze functie hoort deelname aan een consignatiedienst. Tijdens deze periodes ben je buiten kantoortijden bereikbaar voor incidenten zodat de applicatie 24/7 ondersteund kan worden.

Hier ga je werken

Je komt te werken binnen het organisatieonderdeel IT Operatie – Treindigitalisering, in het Real Time Monitoring team.

Dit team ontwikkelt een nieuwe applicatie die realtime data uit de treinenvloot en haar omgeving verwerkt. Deze data bestaat voornamelijk uit sensormetingen en diagnosemeldingen die gebruikt worden voor:

ondersteuning van de dienstregeling (rijdende treinen)
onderhoud en herstel van materieel (treinen)

De nieuwe RTM-oplossing bestaat onder andere uit:

een React viewer voor gebruikers
een cloud-native backend op Microsoft Azure
een integratieplatform dat met treinen en andere systemen communiceert
een data- en rule-engine die realtime informatie verwerkt

Veel onderdelen van het platform worden momenteel opgebouwd. Je krijgt daarom de kans om actief mee te bouwen aan de architectuur, technologiekeuzes en de verdere ontwikkeling van het systeem.

We werken in Scrumteams met sprints van twee weken, waarbij samenwerking, kennisdeling en interne kruisbestuiving met andere teams binnen NS centraal staan.

Dit zijn de functie-eisen

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren developer die zich comfortabel voelt in een cloud-native DevOps-omgeving
en ervaring heeft met schaalbare backend- en data-oplossingen.

Backend & Software Development

Ruime ervaring met C# / .NET development in productieomgevingen
Ervaring met event-driven architecturen en messagingconcepten
Ervaring met API-ontwikkeling zoals REST en asynchrone API’s (bijv. GRPC)
Ervaring met Kusto Query Language (KQL)
Sterke kennis van design patterns, clean code en maintainable software design.

Cloud & Platform

Ervaring met Microsoft Azure
Bekend met platformcomponenten zoals bijvoorbeeld:
Azure Event Hub
Azure Functions
Azure App Service / Azure Logic Apps
Azure Data Explorer (ADX)
Azure Web PubSub

Ervaring met Infrastructure as Code zoals Terraform of Bicep
Ervaring met CI/CD pipelines, bij voorkeur in Azure DevOps
Ervaring met build en release strategie, bij voorkeur blue/green canary deployments.

Data & Streaming

Ervaring met streaming- en dataverwerkingsplatformen zoals Kafka of vergelijkbare technologieën
Bekend met realtime datastromen en hoge datavolumes
Ervaring met dataopslag en -formaten zoals Delta Lake, Parquet of ORC is een pré

Testing & Quality

Ervaring met testautomatisering (unit-, integratie- en loadtests)
Sterke focus op kwaliteit, performance en betrouwbaarheid

Monitoring & Operations

Ervaring met metrics, logging en monitoring (bijv. Grafana, Prometheus of Azure Monitor)
Basiskennis van cloud networking en securityconcepten (VNETs, private endpoints, firewalls)

Wie jij bent

Bij NS vinden we het belangrijk dat collega’s elkaar durven aanspreken en openstaan voor verandering. Daarom zoeken we een developer die:

proactief en oplossingsgericht is
graag samenwerkt in een multidisciplinair team
interesse heeft in complexe technische vraagstukken
graag blijft leren en verbeteren
verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor zowel ontwikkeling als operatie

Samen bouwen we aan een toekomstbestendige Real Time Monitoring oplossing die direct bijdraagt aan de betrouwbaarheid en het onderhoud van de treinenvloot van NS.

Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de dynamische wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. De mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen zijn groot. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. En als één van de mooiste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we nog meer te bieden. Voor deze functie onder meer:

Een salaris tussen € 3.743,- en € 6.491,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 36 uur -inschaling o.b.v. Werkervaring)

3% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
About Mendix

Mendix, a Siemens business, is the global leader in low-code application development. Our platform empowers organizations to rapidly build, integrate, and deploy enterprise-grade applications using visual modeling, abstracting away sophisticated coding. We enable seamless collaboration between business users and developers, accelerating digital transformation for our customers worldwide. Discover how global organizations are innovating with Mendix by exploring our Customer Stories.

About The Role

Are you a passionate and innovative software developer eager to shape the future of application development? Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a talented Junior Software Developer to join our Mendix team. In an era where AI-assisted platforms are revolutionizing how applications are built, Mendix stands at the forefront, empowering both technical and non-technical users to create powerful solutions with unprecedented speed and collaboration.

Unlike traditional programming approaches that can obscure business logic, Mendix offers a clear, visual development environment. This enables diverse stakeholders, from business analysts to software engineers, to actively participate in the development process, fostering understanding and delivering superior applications faster. Your contributions will directly enhance the productivity and innovation capabilities of development communities worldwide.

What You'll Do

Take part in the development of the Mendix platform, a leading low-code application development solution.
Engage in short feedback cycles to break down complex challenges and construct effective solutions.
Take ownership of your work and contribute to team success.
Thrive in a collaborative environment, actively participating in discussions and knowledge sharing.
Contribute to the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptualization and design to testing, deployment, and maintenance.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a motivated individual with:

A Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Demonstrated proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as C# or TypeScript.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and a keen interest in employing them to improve efficiency.
A strong passion for technology, coupled with excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
The ability to learn quickly, adapt to new technologies, and adopt continuous improvement.
Strong communication and social skills, with a desire to work optimally within a team.

What We Offer

At Siemens Digital Industries Software, we are committed to fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment. We offer:

A competitive salary with regular performance evaluations and clear opportunities for career advancement.
Generous paid time off (30 days PTO) to support a healthy work-life balance.
A flexible hybrid work model that combines the benefits of office collaboration with remote flexibility.
Dedicated "crafting days" (2 per month) to focus on personal development, innovation, or learning new skills.
Comprehensive career development training and continuous learning opportunities.
A dedicated training budget for professional development to help you grow your expertise.
Engaging team events and outings, fostering a strong sense of community.
Excellent daily lunch options at the office (where applicable).
Flexible working hours to accommodate individual needs and promote well-being.
Support for various modes of travel to and from the office (where applicable).

Why Us?

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this position is €55-65,000 annually, and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

Location: Rotterdam, Netherlands

Relocation assistance is not provided for this position. Candidates must be able to work from the specified location without company-sponsored relocation support. Additionally, f or this specific role, we are only considering candidates who currently have a valid work permit for the Netherlands and do not require sponsorship.

Als Architect binnen Topicus.Finance versterk je de businessline Hypotheken. Samen bouwen we aan een hoogwaardig, efficiënt en gebruiksvriendelijk hypotheekproces voor dienstverleners én consumenten.

De Impact die je gaat maken als .Net Architect

Met de FORCE Product Suite (FPS)
en het Quion Service Platform (QSP)
bieden wij een end-to-end platform voor hypotheekverwerking. Deze oplossingen ondersteunen enkele van de grootste financiële instellingen van Nederland bij een van hun meest cruciale processen.
Deze functie biedt je de kans om architectuurkeuzes te maken die impact hebben op miljoenen hypotheekprocessen in Nederland. Je werkt samen met vooraanstaande financiële instellingen, ervaren architecten en gedreven ontwikkelteams aan platformen die essentieel zijn voor de Nederlandse hypotheekmarkt. Het platform is continue in ontwikkeling, zowel over de as van nieuwe proposities als de technische doorontwikkeling.
Bij Topicus krijg je de ruimte om richting te geven, te vernieuwen en daadwerkelijk het verschil te maken.

Wat je gaat doen als Architect .NET

Als Architect maak je deel uit van het Solution Architecture Team (SAT) en/of het Core Team. Je werkt nauw samen met productteams, stakeholders en klanten aan de strategische ontwikkeling van onze platformen. Je vertaalt businessdoelstellingen naar duurzame architectuuroplossingen en bewaakt de samenhang binnen een complex applicatielandschap. Daarbij heb je oog voor zowel business capabilities als technische architectuurprincipes, waarbij aspecten zoals security, performance, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid vanzelfsprekend onderdeel zijn van je afwegingen.

In deze rol:
Ontwikkel en bewaak je de architectuurvisie en technologische strategie voor FPS en QSP.
Begeleid en coach je meerdere multidisciplinaire scrumteams in architectuurvraagstukken en technische besluitvorming.
Werk je samen met enterprise-architecten van toonaangevende financiële instellingen zoals ING, Rabobank en de Volksbank.
Zorg je ervoor dat nieuwe ontwikkelingen aansluiten op de doelarchitectuur en de langetermijnstrategie van het platform.
Prioriteer je samen met Product Owners technische en functionele initiatieven en creëer je balans tussen innovatie, onderhoudbaarheid en klantwaarde.
Stel je technologische roadmaps op en adviseer je stakeholders over risico's, kosten en strategische keuzes.
Signaleer je nieuwe businesskansen en vertaal je deze naar technische mogelijkheden binnen onze oplossingen.
Stimuleer je innovatie door actief nieuwe ideeën, technologieën en verbeteringen aan te dragen.

Collaborate with client IT teams, architects, and Sia consultants to deliver technical roadmaps and implementation plans.
Document architecture decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures.
Depending on seniority, mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal capability building within the Azure and AI practice.

Collaborative global environment fostering professional growth and knowledge sharing.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering bij Budget Thuis

Kandidaatprofiel

Over 7 years of experience in engineering leadership, building and scaling high-performing teams
Able to translate company vision and OKRs into technical direction and consistent delivery
Hands-on expertise in CI/CD, DORA metrics, cloud, and security-by-design
Experience working within a product operating model, linking engineering to customer and business value
Skilled in driving transformation, reducing technical debt, and modernizing platforms and processes
Strong communicator, fostering alignment and trust with Product, Business, and C-level stakeholders
Track record of managing and coaching managers

Budget Thuis makes essential household services simple and affordable, and that formula has fueled years of fast growth. Technology plays an ever bigger part in that story, from a new product operating model to major investments in AI. In close partnership with the CTO, the Head of Engineering sets the technical strategy that drives the next phase.

Over Budget Thuis

Gas, electricity, internet, and TV need to be available, reliable, and affordable, without complications. Budget Thuis is the only provider in the Netherlands that brings all these telecom and energy services under one roof. Its no-nonsense approach resonates: households switch to Budget Thuis for the convenience of one provider and the savings that come with it. Based in central Amsterdam, nearly 450 team members operate in an informal yet driven environment, blending a hands-on mindset with a strong focus on results. Together, they deliver exceptional service while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Commercially and operationally, Budget Thuis has built a strong position. Its TV proposition has launched, and by the end of this year its own fiber network will reach 2.4 million households. Rapid expansion and a series of acquisitions have also added complexity to the organization and its systems, opening up room to simplify and scale.

To support further expansion, the company has moved from a project-driven organization to a product operating model. Multidisciplinary teams take end-to-end ownership of processes and the customer experience, coordinated through OKRs, with product, engineering, and the business as equal voices at the table. The new structure is in place and has strong backing from the executive board and the CTO. Now the focus shifts to embedding the new way of working throughout engineering.

“We've laid the foundation for a product engineering culture, now we need a leader who can turn that into consistent execution, at scale, across every team.” - Noureddine Abdelaziz CTO

Vacature Head of Engineering

With ambitious growth goals ahead, the Head of Engineering shapes the technology roadmap and develops a high-performing engineering function that aligns closely with product goals and architectural priorities. The target way of working is clear: trunk-based development with short-lived branches, and automated testing instead of manual QA, with CI/CD and DORA metrics as the backbone. The stack runs on .NET, in a hybrid setup of on-premises infrastructure and Azure.

Leading six Engineering Managers and 92 engineers across seven domains, including a recently added data platform team, the Head of Engineering sets the bar for delivery and technical quality. The markets behind these domains differ widely: internet and TV call for a different approach than mobile or energy. Building a strong management layer to delegate to with confidence is an important part of the job. So is shaping how teams develop and the frameworks they work within, with collaboration and ownership as the norm. Reporting directly to the CTO and part of the CTO’s management team, the Head of Engineering works closely with the Head of Product, forming a leadership duo that connects product and engineering. Collaboration with peers in design, architecture, business, and operations further strengthens this integrated approach.

The timing makes this an attractive moment to join. The heavy lifting of the restructuring is done. What lies ahead is the part where engineering leadership makes the difference. That means completing the transformation, so Budget Thuis can respond faster to what customers need. It also means putting the modernization strategy for the legacy applications into practice. The rollout of AI within engineering is in this leader's hands, with plenty of room to operate. The foundation is already there: a company-wide Centre of Excellence led by the CTO and an in-house GPU server running open-source models. The key choices on automation and AI agents are being made now.

Success in this role rests on technical depth and a genuine enjoyment of people management. That combination ideally grows from a career that started in software engineering and moved step by step into leadership. It gives the credibility to challenge and coach engineers, while the Engineering Managers run day-to-day execution. Experience leading a transformation in a larger organization is essential, as systems thinking here applies to culture and behavior as much as to technology. Microservices, cloud-native technologies, and developer experience are familiar territory. A leader eager to make a lasting impact will find a natural fit here.

Wir Arbeiten In Vielen Unserer Projekte Nach Der Projektmethodik SCRUM, Was Dazu Führt, Dass Du An Den Entsprechenden Ritualen Der Methodik Aktiv Teilnimmst

Sprint (Entwicklungs-Iteration von 2-3 Wochen Länge)
Daily-SCRUM (Tägliches 15 Minuten-Meeting mit dem Team)
Sprint-Retrospektive (Keep, Start, Stop - Evaluation des vergangenen Sprints)
Sprint-Review (Gemeinschaftliche Festlegung von Referenz-Stories und Improvements)
Sprint-Planning (Gemeinsame Planung der Aufgaben für den nachfolgenden Sprint)
Story-Refinement (Ausformulierung der Akzeptanzkritereien in Gruppen)

Du entwickelst deine Lösungen in .NET (Core) mittels C# und Visual Studio (Code), ReSharper und einigen projektspezifischen Extensions.

Du verwendest dabei die neuesten Microsoft Integrationstechnologien on premise und in Azure (Azure Integration Services).

Deine Lösungen wirst du in einem gesonderten Feature-Branch (GIT - Azure DevOps Services) bereitstellen und ggf. nach Reviews von anderen Entwicklern und/oder Architekten und einer Definition of Done anpassen.

Deine Lösungen beinhalten Unit- und Integration-Tests, die die Qualität der Gesamtlösung erhöhen, die mit Hilfe von CI/CD-Pipelines automatisch ausgeführt werden können.

Im Detail

In den ersten Wochen beschäftigst du dich ausführlich mit unseren Onboardings vor allem in die von uns eingesetzten Technologien, Tools und Prozesse.

Du beginnst mit dem Lesen und Ausfüllen verschiedenster Dokumente (Geheimhaltung...)
Anschließend hast du Zeit die bei uns eingesetzten Entwicklungswerkzeuge auf deinem persönlichen Notebook zu installieren, sowie weitere Installationenen und Einrichtungen weiterer Tools nach Anleitung und mit Unterstützung deiner Kollegen bzw. deinem Ansprechpartner/Mentor vorzunehmen.
In den ersten Wochen beschäftigst du dich ausführlich mit unseren Onboardings und in die von uns eingesetzten Technologien, Tools und Prozesse.
Parallel zum Kennenlernen unserer Organisation wirst du dich in den ersten 4 Wochen mit dem technischen Onboarding beschäftigen. Hier bekommst du kleine Entwicklungsaufgaben auf Basis der Technologien, die in dem für dich vorgesehenen Projekt/Produkt eingesetzt werden. Voraussichtlich wirst du dich mit einigen der nachfolgenden Themen beschäftigen dürfen und dazu Entwicklungsaufgaben lösen können:
.NET (Core) Entwicklung in C# im Backend und im Hinblick auf den Einsatz in Ressourcen in Microsoft Azure
DI (IoT), Entwurfsmuster, Clean-Code, SOLID-Prinzipien, Unit-Testing, Integration-Testing (BDD nach Gherkin/SpecFlow)
DevOps in Microsoft Azure DevOps Services unter Verwendung von CI/CD-Pipelines mittels YAML-Definition
GIT Branching- und Merging-Strategien
ALM in Microsoft Azure DevOps Services insbesondere die eigene Aufgabenverwaltung, das Erstellen und Bearbeiten von Pull-Requests und das Vornehmen und Bearbeiten von Code-Reviews
u.v.m.

Nach dem technischen Onboarding wirst du entweder als Teil des Produktteams bei der Entwicklung bzw. Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte unterstützen, oder in einem unserer Kundenprojekte tätig sein. In beiden Fällen setzen wir auf die Projektmethodik SCRUM und die darin enthaltenen Rituale. Somit wirst du definierte Aufgaben aus einem Backlog erhalten, diese Aufgaben bearbeiten und den Status dazu in Dailies kommunizieren.
Parallel zu Produkt- und/oder Projektthemen beschäftigst du dich mit Weiterbildungsthemen, die wir vorab gemeinsam abstimmen. Hierbei kann es sich um von dir ausgewählte Themen handeln, wie beispielsweise
die Entwicklung einer KI in Form eines PoC's zur Lösung wiederkehrender Problemstellungen bei der Softwareentwicklung
ein Besuch einer Entwicklerkonferenz
die Evaluierung der neuesten Quantencomputing-Technologie mit Darstellung eines möglichen Einsatzes bei uns im Unternehmen bzw. bei unseren Kunden.

Wir Erwarten Von Dir

Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung

Zuverlässigkeit & Ehrlichkeit
Verantwortungsbewusstsein

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.

The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
(Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About You

5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open as a hybrid position from our Berlin, London and New York offices.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Architect (mwd)

Als Enterprise Architect sind Sie für die Architektur der gesamten Anwendungslandschaft und deren Integration mit Standardlösungen verantwortlich.

Standort:
München

Vertragsart:
Unbefristete Festanstellung durch unseren Klienten

Aufgaben

Als Enterprise Architect sind Sie für die Architektur der gesamten Anwendungslandschaft und deren Integration mit Standardlösungen verantwortlich. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören:
Weiterentwicklung der Zielarchitektur unter Berücksichtigung von Unternehmensstrategie und Geschäftsprozessen.
Konzeption der Architektur von Unternehmensanwendungen auf Basis von Standardsoftware (u. a. SAP) und Individualentwicklungen (u.a. Flowable) sowie Middleware-Lösungen.
Definition technischer Konzepte und Umsetzung von Workflow-, Prozess- und Integrationslösungen sowie moderner Business-Automation-Lösungen.
Konzeption leistungsfähiger Datenmodelle und Integrationskonzepte für Reporting- und Analyseprozesse.
Schnittstellenarchitekturen zur Integration mit internen und externen Systemen.
Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Data-Warehouse- und Business-Intelligence-Landschaft auf Basis von Microsoft SQL-Server und Power BI.
Etablierung und Weiterentwicklung von Architektur-, Integrations- und Entwicklungsstandards.
Beratung der Fachbereiche, Projektteams und externer Kunden bei Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen.

Ihr Profil

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Software Architect, Solution Architect oder in ähnlicher Position
Erfahrung in der Gestaltung komplexer Anwendungs-, Integrations- und Softwarearchitekturen sowie Kenntnisse moderner Schnittstellentechnologien und Integrationskonzepte (z.B. REST/APIs, Messaging)
Kenntnisse zur Integration von SAP-Systemen in Unternehmensprozesse
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Java - idealerweise Erfahrung mit Spring Boot
Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit Workflow- und BPM-Plattformen (z. B. Flowable, Camunda, Pega, Activiti o. ä.) sowie Cloud-Technologien (AWS, Azure oder GCP), modernen Plattformen und Container-Technologien
Erfahrung zu Data Warehouse und Business Intelligence sowie Microsoft SQL Server und Power BI
Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
Teamfähigkeit und ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenz
Gute Deutsch und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Unser Klient ist Partner von fast 300 Kreditinstituten und somit einer der deutschlandweit führenden Anbieter für Kreditkartenlösungen und -services. Er gestaltet alle Prozesse, die zur Herausgabe und Bearbeitung einer Kreditkarte nötig sind, inklusive Reklamations-/Betrugsbearbeitung und Abrechnung. jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is hiring a Software Engineer III (.NET Full Stack) to join our technology team in Warsaw!

As a Software Engineer III (.NET Full Stack), you’ll work closely with product managers, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to design and develop complex solutions that deliver real value to our customers. Your expertise in .NET, databases, and distributed systems will be key as you optimize and modernize code for performance, scalability, and reliability. You’ll join a highly collaborative Book Team focused on the shipment-booking domain, including carrier offers, shipments available to book, pricing guidance, and the services that enable carrier booking. This is a full-stack role with a strong focus on backend, database, and middle-tier engineering.

At C.H. Robinson, we support a healthy work-life balance through flexible work arrangements. This role is based in Poland, with a preference for candidates in Warsaw or within reasonable commuting distance. The team may meet in the Warsaw office periodically for collaboration, while day-to-day work can be performed flexibly based on what works best for you and the team.

Join us in a fast-paced environment where you can take ownership of meaningful projects, collaborate across our global technology organization, and help modernize critical systems that support how freight is booked!

Define interfaces, develop solutions, and influence architectural changes in partnership with principal engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders.
Optimize, refactor, modernize, and reuse code for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Research complex problems, translate high-level requirements into technical designs, and break smaller projects into deliverable work.
Increase code quality through code reviews, automated testing, and sound engineering practices.
Proactively troubleshoot and resolve production issues across distributed systems.
Implement secure programming patterns and enhance application security.
Estimate project needs and dependencies, communicate progress, and drive work through to completion.
Collaborate actively with engineers across Poland and the United States, sharing opinions, feedback, and technical knowledge.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools for coding, research, and design while applying independent judgement and validating the quality of the output.

*QUALIFICATIONS*

Required

3+ years of experience working in a software development team environment
3+ years of experience creating applications and features in an object-oriented environment (e.g., C#, .NET)
Experience working with relational databases and SQL, including database objects, queries, and data-focused application development

Experience with transportation, logistics, booking, pricing, or other business-critical systems

jobs.description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer
to join our Data Content Development team. This is a software development role focused on building and maintaining data-driven applications and solutions
that support Sphera's product stewardship and regulatory compliance products.

The ideal candidate is an experienced C#/.NET developer who enjoys working with complex datasets, big data and business rules. You will design, develop, troubleshoot, and enhance applications that process large volumes of data and support critical regulatory and compliance products.

You will work closely with software developers, regulatory analysts, and product teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into scalable, reliable solutions. Experience with regulatory compliance, chemical data, or sustainability-related domains is valuable but not required.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain data-driven applications and solutions using C#/.NET within existing application frameworks.
Analyze complex business and technical requirements and translate them into efficient, scalable software solutions.
Work with large datasets and complex data structures while maintaining a strong focus on data quality and performance.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application, database, and data-processing issues.
Collaborate with software developers, regulatory analysts, and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
Contribute to application enhancements, performance improvements, system design, and ongoing product development.
Participate in estimation, planning, testing, deployment, and technical documentation activities.
Support the maintenance and evolution of large-scale regulatory data products and applications.
Work independently on complex technical problems and contribute to long-term improvements to the platform.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

Experience

5+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET development.
Strong object-oriented programming and software development fundamentals.
Experience designing, developing, and supporting data-centric or data-driven applications.

jobs.description:
CAPCO POLAND

We are looking for Poland based candidate.

At Capco Poland,
we’re not just another consultancy - we’re the spark behind digital transformation in the financial world. As a global leader in technology and management consulting, we thrive on helping clients tackle the toughest challenges across banking, payments, capital markets, wealth, and asset management.

Build resilient integration and workflow solutions at the intersection of capital markets, modern technology and digital assets.

The Role

As a Senior Integration & Workflow Engineer
, you’ll provide specialist engineering services focused on designing and developing custom integration and workflow-orchestration components connecting capital markets platforms, blockchain infrastructure and market infrastructure.

Design and develop custom integration and workflow-orchestration components connecting capital markets entity’s platforms, Blockchain infrastructure and market infrastructure. The scope includes delivering resilient, secure and auditable services supporting pre-trade validation, transaction orchestration, settlement processing and downstream system integration..

What You’ll Do

Design and develop custom middleware and workflow-orchestration services
Build REST/API-based integrations with internal and third-party platforms
Implement transaction and workflow state management, including multi-step processing across systems
Develop orchestration logic for Pre-Trade Gateway, DvP/settlement and downstream integration flows
Implement validation, routing, reservation/earmark and transaction-processing logic
Develop adapters and integration services for external platforms and market-infrastructure systems
Implement idempotency, retry, queueing, replay and recovery patterns for resilient transaction processing
Implement asynchronous/event-driven processing where required by detailed architecture
Build robust exception handling, error classification and operational status management
Implement audit logging, monitoring and traceability across end-to-end workflows
Develop data mappings, transformation and canonical integration models
Support authentication, authorization, API security and enterprise security requirements
Develop automated unit/component tests and support SIT/E2E testing
Troubleshoot complex cross-system integration and production issues
Support CI/CD, deployment, configuration and production-readiness activities
Produce technical documentation and support knowledge transfer/handover
Develop and maintain FIX 4.4 message flows and routing logic connecting the existing exchange environment with the DLT/tokenized order flow
Implement FIX message mapping, validation, routing, acknowledgements, execution reports, rejects and error handling for tokenized order flows

What We’re Looking For

Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise integration / middleware applications
Strong hands-on experience with FIX 4.4, including message structures, tags, session management, routing, order lifecycle messages and execution reporting
Experience integrating FIX 4.4-based exchange order flows with API/middleware-based downstream systems, including DLT or other non-traditional market infrastructure.
Strong development experience in Java / Spring Boot, .NET/C#, Node.js/TypeScript or comparable enterprise technology stack
Strong FIX 4.4, REST API and service-integration experience
Experience implementing workflow/orchestration or transaction-processing applications
Experience with asynchronous processing, messaging and event-driven patterns such as Kafka, MQ or equivalent
Strong understanding of distributed-system patterns including idempotency, re-tries, timeouts, circuit breakers, concurrency and failure recovery
Experience with relational databases and persistent transaction/state management
Experience integrating with third-party/vendor APIs
Experience with secure enterprise application development, authentication/authorization and audit logging
Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing and modern deployment practices
Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed applications and interfaces

Domain & Industry Experience

Financial services integration experience, particularly capital markets, payments, trading or settlement
Experience with financial-market messaging standards
Experience developing transaction orchestration in regulated/high-availability environments
Exposure to blockchain/DLT, digital assets, smart assets or custody platforms is preferred

We are seeking a D365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Integration Developer to join the Technology Consulting practice within a premier global professional services firm. X++ development skills and experience with the D365 F&O extension framework.

jobs.title: Web Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Nasz klient to doświadczona firma doradztwa technologicznego, działająca od 2010 roku i realizująca ponad 500 projektów. Specjalizuje się w strategii cyfrowej, projektowaniu UX/UI oraz tworzeniu aplikacji mobilnych, platform webowych i agentów opartych na sztucznej inteligencji. Firma pomaga klientom budować spójne ekosystemy cyfrowe, łącząc kreatywne podejście z solidnym inżynierskim wykonaniem. Oferuje elastyczne modele współpracy — zespoły projektowe, dedykowane oraz dostęp do specjalistów cyfrowych na żądanie — co pozwala dostosować tempo i strukturę pracy do potrzeb klienta. W zespole panuje kultura współpracy, nastawiona na jakość doświadczeń użytkownika i realne wsparcie biznesowe. Obecnie firma poszukuje ekspertów technologicznych: projektantów UX/UI, inżynierów aplikacji mobilnych, web developerów oraz specjalistów AI, którzy chcą współtworzyć zaawansowane produkty cyfrowe na nowoczesnych platformach. To atrakcyjne środowisko dla osób ceniących innowację, pracę zespołową i wpływ na kształtowanie rozwiązań cyfrowych dla klientów z różnych branż.

Web Solution Architect

miejsce pracy: Gdańsk

Na zatrudnioną osobę będą czekały następujące zadania:

Analiza potrzeb biznesowych oraz wymagań funkcjonalnych i niefunkcjonalnych.
Projektowanie docelowej architektury rozwiązań, sposobu integracji, przepływu danych i komunikacji z systemami zewnętrznymi.
Projektowanie skalowalnych integracji, API oraz rozwiązań działających na wielu platformach.
Podejmowanie i uzasadnianie decyzji dotyczących technologii, frameworków, bibliotek i narzędzi.
Ocena wpływu decyzji architektonicznych na wydajność, bezpieczeństwo, utrzymanie, skalowalność i koszt realizacji.
Przygotowywanie dokumentacji architektonicznej, diagramów, standardów technicznych i rekomendacji dla zespołów.
Prowadzenie rozmów discovery z klientami i identyfikowanie rzeczywistych potrzeb, ograniczeń oraz ryzyk.
Prezentowanie proponowanej architektury, rozwiązań technologicznych i estymacji.
Wsparcie przygotowania ofert, estymacji, odpowiedzi na zapytania ofertowe i RFP.
Techniczne prowadzenie zespołów developerskich w całym cyklu życia projektu.
Organizowanie technicznej części Sprintu 0, w tym przygotowanie środowisk, repozytoriów, CI/CD, standardów kodowania, testowania i bezpieczeństwa.
Definiowanie oraz egzekwowanie standardów clean code, dobrych praktyk architektonicznych i zasad jakości.
Prowadzenie przeglądów architektury oraz wspieranie zespołu podczas code review.
Mentoring mniej doświadczonych członków zespołu oraz wspieranie ich w rozwiązywaniu trudnych problemów technicznych.
Identyfikowanie ryzyk technicznych i komunikowanie ich osobom odpowiedzialnym za projekt.
Współpraca z zespołami UX/UI, QA, backend, frontend, mobile, DevOps i Delivery.
Wspieranie odpowiedzialnego wykorzystania narzędzi AI w procesie developmentu, testowania, przeglądów kodu i dokumentacji.
Dbanie o wysokie standardy bezpieczeństwa, ochronę danych i zgodność rozwiązań z wymaganiami GDPR.
Projektowanie architektury nowoczesnych aplikacji webowych.
Projektowanie współpracy pomiędzy frontendem, backendem, API i usługami chmurowymi.
Modernizacja istniejących systemów, refaktoryzacja oraz migracja rozwiązań legacy.
Nadzór nad wydajnością, bezpieczeństwem aplikacji webowych, cache'owaniem, monitoringiem i długiem technicznym.

Nasze Super Wymagania

Minimum 4 lata doświadczenia w roli obejmującej odpowiedzialność architektoniczną lub techniczne prowadzenie projektów, np. Solution Architect, Software Architect, Tech Lead lub Senior Developer.
Wieloletnie, praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu i wdrażaniu aplikacji.
Umiejętność projektowania kompletnych rozwiązań end-to-end, a nie wyłącznie pojedynczych komponentów.
Bardzo dobra znajomość wzorców projektowych, clean architecture, zasad clean code oraz modularnego projektowania systemów.
Doświadczenie w projektowaniu API, integracji z systemami zewnętrznymi i rozwiązaniami backendowymi.
Znajomość procesów CI/CD, automatyzacji testów, code review oraz praktyk zapewniania jakości.
Doświadczenie z architekturą chmurową, np. AWS, Azure lub Google Cloud Platform.
Umiejętność oceny kompromisów pomiędzy wartością biznesową, czasem realizacji, kosztami i złożonością techniczną.
Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu technicznych warsztatów, spotkań z klientami lub prezentacji rozwiązań.
Umiejętność komunikowania zagadnień technicznych zarówno zespołom developerskim, jak i interesariuszom biznesowym.
Doświadczenie w pracy w metodykach Agile/Scrum.
Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego, minimum B2, umożliwiająca swobodną pracę z klientami i międzynarodowymi zespołami.

Wymagania specjalistyczne

Bardzo dobra znajomość architektury nowoczesnych aplikacji webowych.
Praktyczne doświadczenie w projektowaniu aplikacji backendowych i frontendowych.
Doświadczenie w stacku obejmującym PHP, Laravel, React.js lub Vue.js.
Bardzo dobra znajomość REST API i integracji z systemami zewnętrznymi.
Umiejętność projektowania skalowalnych aplikacji, usług backendowych i rozwiązań opartych na architekturze chmurowej.
Znajomość zagadnień związanych z bezpieczeństwem aplikacji webowych, wydajnością, cache'owaniem i monitoringiem.
Doświadczenie w modernizacji systemów, refaktoryzacji lub migracji rozwiązań legacy.

Mile Widziane

Doświadczenie w software house, agencji digital lub firmie realizującej projekty dla zewnętrznych klientów.
Praca przy projektach realizowanych w modelu fixed price.
Doświadczenie w tworzeniu proof of concept i technicznych prototypów.
Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi wspierających development przy użyciu AI.
Doświadczenie w projektach realizowanych przez rozproszone, międzynarodowe zespoły.

Firma Oferuje

Stabilną i długofalową współpracę w oparciu o umowę o pracę lub kontrakt B2B.
Model hybrydowy - pracę z biura w Gdańsku we wtorki i czwartki.
Udział w międzynarodowych projektach dla rozpoznawalnych klientów.
Realny wpływ na architekturę, wybór technologii i sposób realizacji projektów.
Możliwość łączenia pracy architektonicznej, technicznego leadershipu i współpracy z klientami.
Współpracę z doświadczonymi zespołami developerskimi, projektowymi i produktowymi.
Środowisko otwarte na nowe technologie, usprawnienia i inicjatywę.
Prywatną opiekę medyczną, kartę Multisport oraz dofinansowanie nauki języków.
Wynagrodzenie do 34 000 PLN netto miesięcznie na B2B lub odpowiadający tej kwocie całkowity koszt pracodawcy przy umowie o pracę.

Prepare task specifications that are agent-actionable (clear acceptance criteria, referenced modules, explicit constraints)

Set the bar for GraphQL API design, RESTful contracts, database schema, and CI/CD quality across the tribe.
Work with product and engineering leadership to identify high-value problems, propose initiatives, and drive impactful technical direction without direct authority

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs.
Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction.
Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability.
Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment.
Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost.
Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.
Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices.
Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, and API design using REST and GraphQL.
Practical experience with Git branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.

AI-powered engineering (required)

Deep, hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI coding tool such as Claude Code
, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work.
Practical fluency with AI productivity tools across the broader workflow: LLM chat assistants for design and review, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, and research.
Ability to design effective context for AI agents — writing good prompts, structuring repos and docs (e.g. CLAUDE.md / rules files) so agents perform well, and knowing when to delegate vs. when to drive manually.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
and the broader pattern of connecting AI agents to internal tools, data sources, and services.
Awareness of the security, privacy, IP, and quality risks of AI-assisted development, and opinions on how to mitigate them at an organizational level.
Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities and agent-based components into backend products and workflows is a strong plus.

Ways of working

Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end delivery of complex features — from architecture through production.
Excellent analytical skills and a strong self-learning instinct; comfortable ramping up quickly on unfamiliar domains.
Strong communication and influencing skills — able to align engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders around a technical direction.
Excellent written and verbal English.

jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a Software Architect with at least 2-3 years of experience to design solutions and lead development efforts for our clients. In this role, you will collaborate with stakeholders and teams to ensure our technology aligns with business goals while adhering to industry best practices. Your responsibilities will include designing CRM systems and integrations.

We prefer candidates who have prior experience as software developers or lead developers. This position offers a great opportunity for career growth as an architect, especially for those who already have some experience in this role or wish to transition from a lead developer position.

Essential Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any technical field.
5+ years of experience in software development
, with at least 2 years in an architectural or developer lead role.
Knowing
at least one programming language
(e.g., Java, C#, Python) and familiarity with others.
Understanding and practical knowledge of:
architectural patterns (microservices, event-driven, layered, cloud-native, serverless),
architectural drivers,
integration patterns
Having the basic knowledge
and understanding of one of the cloud platforms
(Azure, AWS, etc.), and cloud native architecture.
System diagramming for effective communication (C4, UML).
Data modeling.
Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases
, data streaming (e.g., Kafka), and data migration strategies.
Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent leadership, mentorship, and team coordination abilities.
Communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technology trends.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Your future role

Design and oversee software architectures aligned with business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
Guide and mentor development teams, fostering best practices in coding, design, and architecture.
Evaluate and select appropriate technologies, frameworks, and tools for project success.
Ensure security, compliance, and data privacy are integrated into all architectural decisions.
Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Analyze and optimize system performance, scalability, and reliability.
Manage technical debt and support change management processes.

What we offer

Leadership Role
: an opportunity to lead the architecture and design of high-impact CRM solutions for top-tier clients.

📈Professional Growth
: continuous learning and professional development opportunities, including certifications and training.

💡 Challenging Projects
: work on innovative projects thatleveragethe latest in CRM technology and digital transformation.

💭Collaborative Culture
: a supportive and inclusive work environment that values innovation, teamwork, and diversity.

🏢Flexible Work Environment:
options for flexible work arrangements to support work-life balance.

👉Are you interested in more details? Send us your CV and we´ll contact you withadditionalinformation as soon as possible.

If you are a visionary with a passion for CRM architecture and a deep understanding of the Creatio platform, we want to hear from you! Apply now by submitting your resume. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. All applications will be considered under the terms and conditions of confidentialityin accordance withthe regulations of personal data protection.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Mid Full Stack Developer

Location: Remote (European Time Zone)-once per month in the office in Cracow

Contract Type: B2B

About Us:

ETFBOOK is a Swiss SaaS company providing data, analytics, and custom solutions in the Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) space. Founded in 2020, we aim to make global ETF data accessible, actionable, and valuable for institutional participants, including ETF issuers, index providers, fund service providers, market makers, exchanges, and buy-side institutions.
We develop a platform which offers comprehensive insights through a user-friendly web application and robust APIs, covering areas such as product analysis, fund flow tracking, performance comparisons, and liquidity assessments.

About the role:

We are seeking a Full-Stack Software Developer with interest in Frontend development to join our fully remote team spread across Europe.
You’ll join a highly skilled technology team. This team develops and maintains a cutting-edge data analytics platform using most advanced technologies to support all core business functions. You’ll be a part of a collaborative team focused on the application development. This role offers the chance to make a visible impact in a dynamic, fast-evolving field.

Requirements:

4+ years of experience in Web Application Development, the latest: C#, .Net and Angular
Strong communication skills in English.
A commitment to delivering value to the customer.
An emphasis on automation and code quality (we employ automated testing and deployment).
A can-do attitude, willing to roll up your sleeves, but also capable of thoughtful problem-solving before diving in.
Basic knowledge of Azure
Good communication skills.
Eager to learn.
Able to work under supervision.
Shows basic autonomy in assigned tasks.
English - min B2.

Responsibilities:

Development and maintenance of the frontend part of our application, the latest Angular.
Development of backend services the latest .NET - various APIs and Data Processing.
Participation in Solution Design and Requirements Analysis and Requirements Analysis.

What we offer:

100% remote work from anywhere within the European time zone.
Competitive B2B contract.
Exciting growth opportunities in a fast-paced startup.
Impactful work: help revolutionise ETF data market, currently fastest growing area of finance.
Have a real impact of developing products: your work will directly influence live projects, delivering measurable results in real-world applications.
Culture of innovation: collaborate with forward-thinking professionals in technology and finance where experimentation and creativity are encouraged.
Team- buildings events at least twice a year, hosted in various European locations.

jobs.title: Mobile Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Nasz klient to doświadczona firma doradztwa technologicznego, działająca od 2010 roku i realizująca ponad 500 projektów. Specjalizuje się w strategii cyfrowej, projektowaniu UX/UI oraz tworzeniu aplikacji mobilnych, platform webowych i agentów opartych na sztucznej inteligencji. Firma pomaga klientom budować spójne ekosystemy cyfrowe, łącząc kreatywne podejście z solidnym inżynierskim wykonaniem. Oferuje elastyczne modele współpracy — zespoły projektowe, dedykowane oraz dostęp do specjalistów cyfrowych na żądanie — co pozwala dostosować tempo i strukturę pracy do potrzeb klienta. W zespole panuje kultura współpracy, nastawiona na jakość doświadczeń użytkownika i realne wsparcie biznesowe. Obecnie firma poszukuje ekspertów technologicznych: projektantów UX/UI, inżynierów aplikacji mobilnych, web developerów oraz specjalistów AI, którzy chcą współtworzyć zaawansowane produkty cyfrowe na nowoczesnych platformach. What We Do At Qliro

At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.

What your team does:

The Payments Platform Team builds and runs the payment engine behind every purchase on Qliro - payment transactions, integrations with our Payment Service Providers, and settlements consolidation for our merchants. We operate on the transactional frontline, where high availability and performance aren't optional.

Our tech stack includes:

✅ C# .NET

✅ MS SQL Server, AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Rabbit MQ

✅ Event Driven Architecture

✅ Observability with Grafana and Kibana

✅ AI development with Claude

You can expect to:

Work on a variety of exciting payment‑related projects, processing millions in SEK every day for thousands of customers, with a strong focus on stability, scalability, and security.
Work with modern, AI‑assisted development tools such as Claude to improve productivity, code quality, and collaboration.
Contribute throughout the entire product lifecycle: planning, implementation, testing, release, and maintenance.
Take part in architectural discussions and drive technical improvements.
Collaborate continuously: we strongly believe in teamwork, thoughtful code reviews and shared ownership.
Learn continuously, both on the job and through our learning platform, and share knowledge with your colleagues.
Have fun while working in a fast‑growing area and organisation.

What we are looking for:

You have experience with backend development using our tools or similar technologies.
You understand the fundamentals of system design and API development, and you're comfortable reasoning about data structures and algorithms.
You're communicative and like being involved across the full development cycle, from planning through to following up after release, and take full ownership together with your team.
You are curious and pragmatic about AI, and enjoy exploring how tools like Claude can be used to support better engineering practices and decision‑making.
You are willing to participate in the team’s on‑call rotation (with extra compensation).
You communicate fluently and confidently in English, both verbally and in writing. Swedish is not a prerequisite.

WOW in everything we do

Qliro is the place for you who are curious, passionate and love collaboration. Together we have the power to create wow in everything we do. Feel comfortable being you, bringing your own unique perspectives. At Qliro there is a place for you whoever you are. Differences are a strength.

We love flexibility and remote work, we also believe in the power of meeting in real life. With a mix of working remote and collaborating in the office, we believe in a flexible workplace that suits you and Qliro.

Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.RoleBased in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.QualificationsFor this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:

M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
Several years of professional software development experience.
An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:

Large software projects and mature codebases.
Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
Build and development automation.
Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.Working at COMSOLAt COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.We also offer:
