jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Behind that journey sits a powerful digital platform enabling everything from checkout and payments to order management, delivery, retail tools, and customer self‑service.

You will join a focused team working across a critical part of the customer journey, building and validating solutions that customers globally and hundreds of internal users depend on every day. With real ownership, close collaboration, and global impact, this role plays a key part in ensuring reliability, performance, and quality across Polestar’s digital ecosystem.

We are now looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join Polestar Digital at our headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you will ensure the reliability, performance, and quality of customer‑facing digital products and internal platforms that support the vehicle purchasing journey.

You will work across frontend, backend, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, validating solutions and ensuring that features meet both business and technical requirements before release. Acting as a key partner to Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and Operations teams, you will translate product requirements into effective test strategies and ensure that defects are identified early and resolved efficiently.

The role combines hands‑on testing, automation, and continuous improvement of quality practices, contributing to scalable and high‑quality systems used globally across markets and internal operations. You will also stay up to date with modern QA methodologies and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches.

What you'll do

You will ensure high‑quality delivery across Polestar’s digital platforms by validating solutions, improving test coverage, and driving continuous improvement in quality practices.

Your Responsibilities Include

Ensuring business requirements and acceptance criteria are fulfilled through comprehensive testing of user stories and system workflows
Designing, executing, and maintaining manual and automated tests across frontend, backend, APIs, and integrations
Validating quality, reliability, performance, and security of new platform capabilities and releases
Collaborating with Software Engineers, Technical Leads, Product Managers, and Designers to translate product requirements into effective test strategies
Identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects, while supporting teams in root‑cause analysis and resolution
Contributing to test automation frameworks and improving overall test coverage and development practices
Working closely with cross‑functional agile teams to continuously improve software quality and delivery processes
Monitoring and evaluating quality metrics and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives
Staying up to date with industry best practices, modern QA methodologies, and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches
Documenting test plans, test results, and quality standards across the development lifecycle

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, Technical Leads, and Operations teams, ensuring alignment across technical and business needs while driving quality across the full development lifecycle.

Who you are

You are a structured and analytical quality professional with strong ownership and a proactive approach to ensuring high‑quality outcomes. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams, and you focus on identifying and resolving issues early to enable smooth and reliable delivery.

You combine hands‑on testing expertise with a continuous improvement mindset and an interest in modern technologies shaping the future of software quality.

To be a great fit for this position, we believe you have:

Strong knowledge and hands‑on experience with Quality Assurance methodologies and software testing principles
Experience testing modern web applications and distributed systems across frontend and backend technologies
Experience with test automation tools and frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing
Understanding of React, TypeScript, .NET (C#), Node.js, APIs, and AWS‑based systems from a testing perspective
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub workflows, and containerized environments
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and experience working in cross‑functional product teams
Strong analytical, organizational, problem‑solving, and communication skills
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and stakeholders
Experience with commerce, payments, financing, order management, or customer journey platforms is considered an advantage
Atleast 4 years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance

People at Polestar

We know that a change is needed. We also know that each one of us can help bring about that change. Our commitment to becoming climate‑neutral by 2040 is just as important to us as being inclusive, diverse, and innovative.

Together, we are creating, collaborating, and experimenting to usher in a new era of sustainable mobility. We are an electric performance brand, determined to improve the society we live in.

Is this you?

If you are interested in joining the Polestar crew, don’t wait to submit your application. We apply a continuous selection process and the job post will remain open until the position is filled.

As we move through the Swedish summer holiday season, there may be a slight delay in our process. We look forward to getting back to you in August.

Send us your resume along with a short note on what makes this role interesting to you. We read everything.

Are you ready for the journey? Which is electric, by the way…

jobs.title: Head of Application Development
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Vill du vara med och leda utvecklingen av mjukvara som gör skillnad för cancerpatienter världen över? 

På RaySearch kombinerar vi avancerad teknik med ett tydligt syfte: att förbättra cancervården genom innovativ mjukvara som används på cancerkliniker världen över. Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett starkt teknikintresse med ett meningsfullt uppdrag, där ditt ledarskap bidrar till att göra skillnad för människor varje dag.

Nu genomför vi en förändring inom vår utvecklingsorganisation och söker två erfarna ledare till våra nya sektioner Application Development 1 och Application Development 2. Rollerna är centrala i arbetet med att stärka och vidareutveckla vår applikationsutveckling. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för att bygga en stark, skalbar och högpresterande utvecklingsorganisation med fokus på förbättringsarbete, kompetensutveckling, samarbete och leverans. Som en del av vår nya linjeorganisation med fem sektioner inom utvecklingsavdelningen kommer ni att arbeta nära de övriga sektionerna som ansvarar för produktutvecklingens inriktning och genomförande, produkternas säkerhet och validering samt fysik och algoritmutveckling.

Om rollen

Som Head of Application Development ansvarar du för att utveckla organisationen bakom RaySearchs produkter vilka inkluderar RayStation, ett avancerat dosplaneringssystem för strålbehandling, och RayCare, ett innovativt onkologiskt informationssystem som stödjer hela cancerbehandlingsprocessen. Vi arbetar med en modern teknikstack som bland annat omfattar C#, .NET, SQL Server, WPF och React.

Du rapporterar till Director of Development och leder ett antal gruppchefer. Hur ansvar och direktrapporter fördelas mellan de två rollerna avgörs utifrån verksamhetens behov och de personer som tillträder tjänsterna. Ni arbetar nära varandra för att utveckla både era sektioner och avdelningen som helhet.

I rollen som Head of Application Development leder du arbetet med att sätta riktningen för applikationsutvecklingen och ser till att organisationen har förmågan att omsätta den i väl fungerande produkter. Det innebär bland annat att:

•  Utforma och kommunicera strategi för mjukvaruarkitektur, designprinciper och teknisk inriktning.

•  Skapa arbetssätt och styrning som bidrar till hög kvalitet och lösningar som är enkla att vidareutveckla och kan växa med behoven.

•  Driva förbättringsarbete kring utvecklingsprocesser, verktyg, utvecklarnas produktivitet och användningen av AI. 

•  Bygga långsiktig teknisk kompetens utifrån verksamhetens och produkternas behov.

•  Säkerställa rätt bemanning, kompetens och organisatoriska förutsättningar för framgångsrik produktutveckling.

•  Stärka samarbetet mellan team och funktioner så att gemensamma prioriteringar får genomslag.

•  Leda och utveckla chefer och tekniska ledare.

Din profil

Du är en erfaren ledare med bakgrund från avancerad mjukvaruutveckling. Genom din tekniska kompetens och förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur, utvecklingsprocesser och tekniska vägval kan du bidra till både strategiska beslut och operativ utveckling. Du kan förena långsiktig teknisk strategi med de praktiska förutsättningar som krävs för att team ska kunna leverera med hög kvalitet.

Vi söker dig som har en masterexamen (M.Sc.) eller likvärdig utbildning och som kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Du har gedigen erfarenhet av att driva processförbättringar och öka operativ effektivitet samt ett starkt fokus på resultat, kvalitet och genomförande. Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av att jobba med medicinskteknisk mjukvara eller inom en annan reglerad verksamhet.

Som ledare har du mycket god kommunikativ förmåga och kan på ett trovärdigt sätt bygga engagemang, skapa samsyn och förmedla både strategiska och tekniska budskap till olika målgrupper. Du driver förändring och får människor med olika kompetenser att lyckas tillsammans. Du trivs i en prestigelös miljö där framgång skapas genom samarbete, kunskapsdelning och gemensamt ansvarstagande.

Ansökan

Du är välkommen att söka tjänsten genom formuläret nedan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail men har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef Henrik Friberger, henrik.friberger@raysearchlabs.com

jobs.title: Backend & DevOps-konsult (direktuppdrag) - Kollarna.se
jobs.description:
På Doktor.se definierar vi om det svenska sjukvårdssystemet genom att göra det mer tillgängligt, smidigt och effektivt, utan att kompromissa med kvalitet eller säkerhet. Vår hybridmodell, som kombinerar fysiska vårdcentraler med moderna digitala lösningar, har gjort oss till den största digitala vårdgivaren i Sverige, med miljontals konsultationer varje år.

Om uppdraget

Vi söker en erfaren Backend- och DevOps-konsult för ett uppdrag hos Kollarna.se, en tjänst som erbjuds av Doktor.se:s dotterbolag Doktor24.se. Vi vill arbeta direkt med dig som konsult, utan mellanhänder.

Uppdraget syftar till att stärka och modernisera Kollarnas infrastruktur i Azure, med fokus på säkerhet, skalbarhet och automatisering. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med Kollarnas utvecklingsteam och driver dina leveranser självständigt mot överenskomna mål.

Vad uppdraget innebär

Uppdraget omfattar följande leveranser:

Genomlysning av nuvarande Azure-miljö och säkerhetsläge, med prioriterade åtgärdsförslag.
Införande av infrastructure as code för befintliga tjänster.
Översyn och förenkling av CI/CD-pipelines i GitHub Actions.
Uppsättning av monitorering och larm, samt översyn av skalbarhet, t.ex. databaser och cachning (Redis).
Rådgivning i design- och arkitekturfrågor som rör leveranserna ovan.
Dokumentation och överlämning till teamet vid uppdragets slut.

Vem vi söker

Du har gärna 5 år eller mer som backendutvecklare med erfarenhet av DevOps, som infrastrukturingenjör eller i liknande roll, framför allt i Azure-miljöer (erfarenhet av AWS är meriterande). Kollarnas backend är skriven i C# .NET och frontend i TypeScript/React. Erfarenhet av TypeScript och/eller Python är meriterande.

Du kan drifta Azure-tjänster med hjälp av exempelvis GitHub Actions, har god erfarenhet av databaser och SQL, framför allt MS SQL, och vet hur man bäst utnyttjar Azure-tjänster och sätter upp exempelvis Redis. Du har erfarenhet av att sätta upp och underhålla monitorering, tänker säkerhet först och har gedigen kunskap om hur man skyddar infrastruktur mot intrång.

Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

Varför uppdraget är intressant

Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

Uppdragsvillkor

Uppdragsform:
Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

Uppdragslängd:
Enligt överenskommelse.

Omfattning:
40 timmar per vecka.

Start:
Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

Arbetsplats:
Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

Ersättning:
Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

Övrigt:
Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

Var med och gör skillnad i vården!

Våra kunder står inför strategiska beslut kring plattformar, arkitektur, styrning och AI-adoption. De beslut som fattas idag kommer att påverka deras förmåga att utveckla verksamheten, skapa innovation och dra nytta av data under många år framöver. 

Att fatta rätt beslut från början är avgörande. Fel arkitektur kan bromsa utveckling, öka kostnader och begränsa möjligheten att skapa värde från investeringar i data och AI.

Senior Software Developer - Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U)

Do you want to make the world a safer place while being part of a team that truly values experience and collaboration?

Would you like to join a global and technically skilled team that plays an essential role in Verisure’s success?

The platform organisation in Malmö develops and operates the software that underpins Verisure's alarm and smart home systems. We are responsible for the services that keep millions of connected devices online, upgradeable, and traceable, from the moment a device is manufactured until it is returned or decommissioned.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Developer in Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U), you will join a team of around 11 backend engineers building and operating a portfolio of internal platform services. These cover device lifecycle management (factory provisioning, firmware upgrades, SIM management) and internal operator and support tooling used daily by Verisure technicians and administrators. Several of these services run with 24/7 SLA requirements; device provisioning and support tooling are business-critical, always-on parts of the platform.

You will design, build, and operate microservices spanning device lifecycle management, SIM connectivity, firmware/upgrade orchestration, and internal utility tooling. You will work closely with the team's Product Owner, fellow developers, and PU&U's external EMS partners to translate manufacturing and operational requirements into reliable software. You are expected to take technical ownership of parts of the system, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor less experienced developers.

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation, not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages, spanning millions of connected devices, is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Location:
Malmö (5-minute walk from the Central Station)

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation — not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages — spanning millions of connected devices — is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Who are you?

We are looking for an experienced backend developer with a strong technical foundation and the confidence to take ownership of complex, business-critical services. You enjoy working in an environment with a long-term technical vision but shifting short-term priorities, and you communicate clearly with both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders. You take pride in code quality, system reliability, and helping the team improve its ways of working.

Required

Several years of hands-on experience as a backend software developer, ideally in a microservice/distributed systems environment
Solid experience with Java and Spring Boot
Experience with containerised deployment (Docker, Kubernetes)
Fluency in English (verbal and written)

Also, Great If You Have

Experience with message-driven architecture (e.g. RabbitMQ)
Experience with relational databases (e.g. MySQL)
Frontend experience (React/JavaScript) is a plus, though not the core focus of the role
Familiarity with device lifecycle management, IoT connectivity, or hardware/software integration
Experience working in an environment with external hardware/manufacturing partners
AWS experience

About Verisure

Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.

For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company’s track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.

Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.

Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed in the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, this was the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in over 25 years.

My team and I eagerly await your application! Join us on this journey towards a safer, smarter world. Apply today!

Verisure is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We are an international company with offices and colleagues in multiple countries.

We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud Operations Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking to join our Cloud & Infrastructure Services team. This role combines strong cloud operations capability with advanced knowledge of network architecture and protocols. Lead or support incident response, root cause analysis, problem management, maintenance, and service restoration for production infrastructure.

Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routing, BGP, VPNs, proxies, load balancing, TLS, and network security principles.

Experience with enterprise firewalls, network virtual appliances, web application firewalls, and traffic management technologies.
Experience using Terraform for repeatable, controlled Infrastructure as Code deployments.
Experience operating production services, responding to incidents, managing changes, and completing root cause analysis.
Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.

Experience with Fortinet, F5, or comparable enterprise firewall and application delivery platforms.
Experience with Azure Virtual WAN, Azure Route Server, multi-region connectivity, and multi-cloud networking.
Knowledge of Zero Trust networking, PCI-DSS controls, and network segmentation in regulated environments.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms and analysis of network and security telemetry.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We make cargo talk. Why? Because a third of all food and pharma produce is wasted on the way to consumers, and we're out to change that. Our smart tracker Emma, made from recycled ocean plastic, travels with temperature-sensitive shipments for enterprise customers in food, pharma and seafood across 20+ countries. We're looking for a seasoned engineer to own the platform behind it, and to build it for ten times the fleet we run today.

What you'll do Own our Azure cloud platform end to end: architecture, ingestion, data, cost, and the calls about what we run and why.
Push AI-assisted development further than most dare. Claude writes most of our code and a human owns every merge. You'll define how far that goes for production infrastructure, and build the guardrails.
Scale ingestion and the data tier for a fast-growing fleet, without per-device cloud cost rising with it.
Make reliability unremarkable: no reading silently lost, late and backfilled data handled gracefully, and monitoring that spots trouble before a customer does.
Grow the data platform so questions about the fleet or a single shipment are answered in seconds, not filed as tickets.

Our stack A cloud-native platform on Azure: event-driven IoT ingestion, serverless services, and both operational and analytical data stores. CI/CD carries much of what we ship, a human reviews every change, and turning more of our infrastructure into code is a job we want you to own. AI runs through development, operations and analysis, and we are leaning into what is now just possible. We're ISO 27001 certified and our customers are audited, so security shapes real engineering decisions. We'll go through the details with you in the interview.

What you bring Deep experience in building and operating production cloud infrastructure: Azure, or another major cloud and the appetite to go Azure-deep.
Real conviction about AI-assisted development, with the judgement to know when to slow down and verify.
A curious, fast-learning mind. Being a jack-of-all-trades is a real plus here.
Fluency with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability.
Strong Postgres and SQL, and sound instincts for modelling time-series data at volume.

Nice to have: IoT or telemetry at fleet scale, cellular (LTE-M, NB-IoT), ISO 27001/SOC 2 environments, Python, and cloud cost engineering.

What we offer Competitive salary, good pension, and share options. Own a piece of what you build.
Flexible hours and location; a welcoming office at Kjelsås Stasjon with parking and good transit connections. Our team tends to spend about half their time at the HQ.
Your choice of tools, plus best-in-class AI tools with generous quotas.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Som Senior DevOps Engineer hos Webstep får du muligheten til å jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom utvikling, operations og plattform for noen av de viktigste virksomhetene i Norge. Du får samarbeide med dyktige fagfolk som brenner for teknologi, og du får frihet til å ta ansvar, påvirke beslutninger og bidra til å utvikle fremtidens løsninger.

Vi ser etter deg som vil være med å bygge et av Norges sterkeste fagmiljøer for seniorkonsulenter. Hos oss handler det ikke bare om å levere. Det handler om å skape løsninger som varer, og å gjøre det sammen med folk du trives med.

Vi ønsker at du har:

Minimum 5 års erfaring som DevOps Engineer, eller 3+ års utviklererfaring kombinert med 2+ års DevOps-erfaring
Solid forståelse av nettverk og sikkerhet, logging, varsling og hvordan applikasjoner kommuniserer (REST, messaging services, monitorering og overvåkning)
Erfaring med Infrastructure as Code (IaC) og scripting, gjerne med Terraform, Bicep, eller Ansible.
Hands-on erfaring med containere (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD og minst én av skyplattformene Azure, AWS eller GCP
Erfaring med å sette opp enterprise-løsninger for autentisering og tilgangsstyring (f.eks. GitHub Enterprise), og strukturere arbeidsmetodikk på tvers av team
Du trives med å jobbe tett med kunder, forstår deres behov og bryr deg om at løsningene faktisk fungerer i praksis
Du er god til å forklare komplekse løsninger på en enkel måte, både muntlig og skriftlig, på norsk og engelsk
Sertifiseringer som AZ-305, AZ-400, KCNA eller andre generelle sky/devops-sertifiseringer er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som trives med mange baller i lufta og ad-hoc-styrte dager der ting skjer kontinuerlig. Du er fleksibel, tar initiativ og finner motivasjon i å være den som binder sammen utvikling, operations og plattform.

Du bryr deg om mer enn bare kode og infrastruktur. Du leverer godt, tar initiativ og involverer deg i det som skjer. Enten det er på Slack, et arrangement eller ute hos kunde. Du har høy integritet og vet at ved å dele kunnskap så blir alle bedre. Kanskje liker du å skrive blogger, holde foredrag eller bidra i faggrupper? Hos oss får du muligheten til nettopp det. De beste løsningene skapes tross alt i team der folk utfordrer hverandre og tør å tenke nytt.

Du er kanskje en person som forventer at arbeidsgiver skal stille samme høye krav til seg selv som de gjør til sine ansatte. Du bryr deg om trivsel, faglig utvikling og langsiktig vekst, og ønsker å være en del av et selskap som virkelig investerer i folkene sine.

Hvorfor Webstep?

Webstep er bygget på tanken om at de beste løsningene skapes av folk som har det bra. Derfor investerer vi tungt i både faglig utvikling og sosiale arenaer. Ikke fordi vi må, men fordi vi mener det.

Faglig utvikling på dine premisser

Hos oss får du tilgang til et av bransjens sterkeste fagmiljøer. Vi deler kunnskap på fagkvelder, kompetansehelger og vår årlige fagdag: en intern konferanse der kolleger holder innlegg, vi flyr inn inspirerende keynote-speakers, og det hele avsluttes med fest og sosialt. Fagdagen skjer på en lørdag, slik at du ikke mister lønn for å delta.
Vi deltar på og er sponsorer for konferanser som JavaZone og NDN, og støtter sertifiseringer og kurs som gir mening for deg. Vi har også rollen som faglig fyrtårn! Rollen går på åremål og du blir løftet fram for å representere Webstep faglig, holde foredrag og sitte i vårt nasjonale fagråd. Med andre ord kan du være med å sette Websteps faglige retning!
Brenner du for noe spesifikt? Kanskje du vil starte en faggruppe med fokus på platform engineering, sette opp et hackathon, eller få inn en internasjonal ekspert til å snakke om et tema du er opptatt av? Bare spør. Vi sier sjelden nei til gode initiativ.

En kultur som faktisk fungerer

Vi er ikke bare kollegaer. Vi er folk som kjenner hverandre godt. Gjennom året møtes vi på nyttårsbord, sommerfest, vintertur, høsttur (til utlandet), konsulenttur, lønningspils og bedriftslag som klatring, padel, sjakk og brettspill. Og ja, familien din er velkommen med på flere sosiale sammenkomster i året. Vi tror at når du blir kjent med kollegaene dine utover jobb, bygger vi et sterkere fellesskap.

Vår organisasjonsstruktur er flat og uformell. Vi har ingen lag på lag med ledelse. Konsulentledere har én jobb: å følge opp deg. Ikke rekruttering, ikke salg, ikke ti andre oppgaver, bare deg. Vår CEO sitter på kontoret, er tilgjengelig og har åpen dør. Det er lav terskel for å slå av en prat med hvem som helst, uansett rolle.

Frihet og fleksibilitet

Hos oss får du frihet til å velge prosjekter som passer deg, og fleksibilitet til å legge opp hverdagen din sammen med kunden. Er det greit for kunden, er det greit for Webstep. Vi tror at folk som får frihet, tar ansvar, og det er akkurat sånn vi liker å jobbe.
Du får jobbe med spennende kunder i bransjer som energi, bank og finans, helse, handel og offentlig sektor. Det betyr at du kan bidra til å forme samfunnet, samtidig som du utvikler deg faglig .

Et arbeidsmiljø som investerer i deg

Vi kutter aldri på fag eller sosialt. Vi bruker betydelige ressurser på trivsel, kompetansebygging og på å skape en arbeidsplass der folk faktisk vil være. Vi har gode forsikringer, pensjonsordning og konkurransedyktig lønn, men det viktigste for oss er at du føler at du vokser, både faglig og som menneske.

Klar for å ta Websteppet?

Har du kompetansen, engasjementet og liker det du leser om oss tar vi gjerne en uforpliktende prat for å se om vi er en god match!

Om rollen

Vi vet at du har mange valgmuligheter i Oslo. Det vet sannsynligvis LinkedIn også.

Derfor skal vi ikke bruke tiden din på å fortelle at vi er «ledende», «innovative» eller «verdens beste arbeidsplass». Det som betyr noe, er om du får interessante utfordringer, dyktige kolleger og muligheten til å utvikle deg videre.

Det får du hos oss.

Som Test Automation Engineer – Quality Engineering & AI hjelper du kundene våre med å bygge kvalitet inn i løsningene fra første dag. Du kombinerer teknisk testkompetanse med moderne automatisering og utforsker hvordan AI kan bidra til bedre kvalitet, raskere leveranser og økt forretningsverdi.

Du vil jobbe tett med utviklere, arkitekter, produkteiere og andre fagpersoner i tverrfaglige team. Samtidig blir du en del av Sogetis fagmiljø innen Quality Engineering & Testing, der vi deler kunnskap, utfordrer etablerte arbeidsformer og utforsker ny teknologi sammen.

Gode ideer kan oppstå mange steder, enten det er i et kundemøte, ved kaffemaskinen eller på en tur i Marka. Det viktigste er at vi deler dem, og gjør noe med dem.

I denne rollen vil du:

Utvikle og vedlikeholde automatiserte tester som en integrert del av moderne utviklings- og leveranseprosesser.
Bidra til kvalitet gjennom hele utviklingsløpet, fra krav og design til produksjonssetting.
Jobbe med CI/CD, DevOps og kontinuerlig testing i smidige team.
Ta i bruk moderne testverktøy og AI-støttede arbeidsformer for å styrke kvalitet og effektivitet.
Rådgi kunder og bidra til å etablere gode test- og kvalitetsprosesser.

Din profil

Du har erfaring med testautomatisering, teknisk testing, kvalitetssikring eller systemutvikling.
Du har god programmeringsforståelse og bruker kode som et naturlig verktøy i arbeidet ditt.
Du har erfaring fra konsulentvirksomhet og/eller andre kundenære leveransemiljøer.
Du har erfaring fra smidige utviklingsprosjekter og gjerne DevOps-orienterte leveransemiljøer.
Du kommuniserer godt med både tekniske og forretningsmessige interessenter.

Vi blir ekstra nysgjerrige dersom du:

Har erfaring med Playwright, Cypress, Selenium eller tilsvarende verktøy og rammeverk.
Har erfaring med Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira eller tilsvarende plattformer.
Har erfaring med API-testing og integrasjon av automatiserte tester i CI/CD.
Har ISTQB-sertifisering eller andre relevante faglige sertifiseringer.
Har erfaring med teknisk rådgivning og direkte samarbeid med kunder.

AI og moderne kvalitetsarbeid

For noen er AI fortsatt et eksperiment. For andre har det allerede blitt en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen.

Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig på hvordan AI kan brukes til å utvikle bedre tester, effektivisere arbeidsprosesser, og skape mer verdi i kundeprosjekter.

For kandidater på seniornivå forventer vi at du bruker relevante AI-verktøy i arbeidshverdagen og kan vise til konkrete eksempler på hvordan dette har forbedret kvalitet, produktivitet eller leveranser. Det kan for eksempel være innen testdesign, generering av testdata, testautomatisering, dokumentasjon, feilanalyse eller kodeutvikling.

For kandidater på lead-nivå forventer vi i tillegg at du kan etablere gode arbeidsformer, veilede kolleger og hjelpe kunder med å identifisere områder der AI og automatisering kan gi målbare kvalitetsforbedringer.

Hvorfor vi tror du vil trives hos oss

Du blir en del av et sterkt fagmiljø innen Quality Engineering & Testing i Oslo.
Du får arbeide med komplekse løsninger og varierte problemstillinger i både privat og offentlig sektor.
Du får utvikle deg gjennom faglige fellesskap, sertifiseringer og praktisk erfaring.
Du får kombinere lokal nærhet med tilgang til Capgemini-konsernets globale kompetanse og partnernettverk.
Du blir en del av et miljø som vet at den beste ideen ikke nødvendigvis kommer fra personen med høyest tittel, eller fra det lengste møtet.

Søknad

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, hører vi gjerne fra deg.

Vi vet selvfølgelig at de beste kandidatene ikke alltid krysser av på alle punkter. Hvis du har en sterk interesse for kvalitet, teknologi og kontinuerlig læring, og kjenner deg igjen i deler av rollen, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

De fleste av oss matcher jo tross alt ikke 100 prosent med vår egen LinkedIn-profil heller.

Please note that all candidates must be fluent in Norwegian.

Som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess vil identitetsverifisering bli gjennomført ved kontroll av ID-kort, og bakgrunnssjekker kan utføres ved behov.

Om Sogeti

Sogeti, en del av Capgemini Group, gjør teknologi enkelt og verdiskapende. Vi er spesialister på AI-drevne løsninger innen Quality Engineering & Testing, data og cloud, og vi omsetter raskt ideer til handling. Sogeti leverer konkrete resultater, hjelper organisasjoner med å innovere med trygghet og skaper verdi fra dag én. Vi er agile, hurtige og drar nytte av sterke partnerskap.

Våre lokale team jobber side om side med kundene våre og bygger nære relasjoner ved å forstå deres virkelighet. Sammen med Capgemini-konsernets globale styrke og bransjeekspertise skaper vi skalerbare resultater.

Sogeti Norge har 150 ansatte på fem lokasjoner: Oslo, Bergen, Sandefjord, Stavanger og Trondheim. Selskapet er ledende på Quality Engineering & Testing i Norge.

Right here. Right now.

jobs.title: Software developer
jobs.description:
Etsimme Sovelluskehittäjää
vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

Sijainti:
Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

Vastuualueet:

Sovelluskehittäjänä:

Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI-suunnittelijat.
Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

Kenen kanssa työskentelet?

Työskentelet osana T woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.

Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

Odotamme sinulta:

Vähintään 3 vuoden kokemus.
Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: C#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript.
Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle.
Pilviosaamista: Azure tai AWS.
Kokemusta mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
Englannin kielen osaaminen.
Olet oma-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

Katsomme eduksi

Jos sinulla on kokemusta jostain seuraavista osaamisista:

Kokemusta WMS / RabbitMQ
Skaalatusta ketterästä kehityksestä (esim. SAFe).
Turvaverkoista (Tuve).
Integraatioista.
Julkisen organisaation hankkeista.
Standardi / EU dokumentaation ymmärrys.
Viranomaisdokumentaation ymmärrys.

Meille on tärkeää, että osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja kommunikoit aktiivisesti sekä avoimesti, olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen. Haluat tehdä työsi laadukkaasti ja oikein. Olet innokas kehittämään ja haastamaan itsesi sekä tiimisi can-do -asenteella.

Miltä onnistuminen roolissa näyttää?

Ensimmäisen kuuden kuukauden tavoitteesi kiteytettynä:

Olet läpäissyt turvallisuusselvityksen.
Olet päässyt hyvin osaksi työyhteisöä ja osoittautunut loistavaksi lisäksi tiimiimme.
Olet sisäistänyt asiakkaan toimialan ja perehtynyt sisään hankkeeseen.
Osaamisesi on osoittautunut relevantiksi asiakasprojekteissamme.

Auttaaksemme sinua menestymään, tarjoamme sinulle perehdytysohjelman, koulutuksia, sertifikaatteja sekä työyhteisön, joka omalla osaamisellaan ja tekemisellään tukee työssä oppimistasi ja urakehitystäsi. Lisäksi inklusiivinen kulttuurimme tarjoaa useita mahdollisuuksia tutustua uusiin työkavereihin sekä työn että hauskanpidon merkeissä.

Mitä Twoday tarjoaa sinulle?

Jäykkien organisaatiorakenteiden ja korkean hierarkian sijaan yksikkömme tarjoaa sinulle autonomiaa ja joustavuutta tukevan työympäristön.

Etuihimme kuuluu:

Markkinatasoinen työsuhde-etujen paketti sisältäen:
Lounas ja virike-etu
Työterveyshuolto
Auntie mielen hyvinvoinnin tukipalvelut
Mahdollisuus valita omat työvälineesi

Vahva tuki ammatilliselle kehittymiselle:
Online-oppimisympäristöt: Udemy
Teknologiasertifioinnit, joista toisinaan palkitaan myös bonuksin
Koulutukset ja community-tapaamiset
Yhteisölliset oppimissessiot työkavereiden kanssa (esim. hackathon tapahtumat)

Paljon vapaa-ajan aktiviteetteja, kuten:
Koko firman tapahtumat
Toimitustiimien omat tapahtumat
Kaikille avoimia ja vapaasti perustettavia harrastekerhoja, mm. maastopyöräily, juoksu, lautapelit, neulonta, e-urheilu, padel.

Tehtävään hakeminen:

Voit hakea tehtävään helposti LinkedIn-profiilillasi tai CV:llä. Hakemuskirje on vapaaehtoinen. Palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian!

Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Huomioithan, että voimme edetä ainoastaan hakijoiden kanssa, joilla on työntekoon oikeuttava oleskelulupa Suomessa.

Työskentely Twodaylla

Twoday on johtava teknologiakonsultointiyritys, joka auttaa organisaatioita hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja edistyksellisiä teknologioita käytännössä. Meitä on noin 2 300 asiantuntijaa tekoälyn, datan, digitaalisen kehityksen ja pilvipalveluiden parissa. Autamme asiakkaitamme selkeyttämään monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, vähentämään epävarmuutta ja saamaan teknologiasta konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä.

Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.

Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?

Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC.

We are now looking for a Integration Engineer
to strengthen our team in Helsinki. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain integration solutions that connect cloud services, enterprise systems, and business-critical applications. You will work closely with customers and internal delivery teams to ensure integrations are reliable, secure, and scalable.

The role combines hands-on technical work with responsibility for contributing to and shaping integration architectures that support long-term business needs. You will take an active role across the full lifecycle of integration projects, from solution design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will

Design and implement API based and event driven integration solutions
Design integration solutions following Azure best practices and cloud native patterns
Build integrations using Azure Integration Services such as Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Hubs
Develop and maintain integrations using C# and the .NET ecosystem
Apply Infrastructure as Code practices using tools such as Terraform
Ensure secure authentication, authorization, and API security using OAuth and best practices
Collaborate with architects, developers, and customers to design end to end integration solutions
Support deployments, monitoring, and continuous improvement of integration platforms, ensuring reliability and observability in production environments

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of experience in API and integration development
Strong expertise in Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs)
Hands on experience with Infrastructure as Code (tools such as Terraform)
Good understanding of OAuth authentication and API security best practices
Ability to take ownership of integration solutions and make technical decisions in customer projects
Experience with C# programming and the .NET ecosystem, particularly when building Azure Functions or custom integration components
Fluency in both Finnish and English
Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Nice to have

Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate
Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Expertise in BizTalk
Previous experience delivering or managing integrations in large organizations
Broader data engineering development experience to contribute to both integration and data projects

Why Norrin?

At Norrin, you'll join an international team
of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with Nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges
keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.

We invest in continuous learning
through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities
where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you.

We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect
, with psychological safety at its core .
As a member of the Women in Tech network, we're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model
combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we offer comprehensive benefits
, including extensive occupational healthcare and dental care, insurance coverage, regular massages, and culture and sports benefits. Our compensation model includes a competitive base salary, a performance-based bonus
, and the opportunity to participate in an employee fund.

Could this be your next opportunity?

We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Etsimme kokeneita Data Engineerejä rakentamaan Netumin tulevaisuutta.

Haemme muutoksentekijöitä uuteen, tekoälypohjaisiin dataratkaisuihin ja moderniin tietovarastointiin keskittyvään yksikköömme.

Pääset haastamaan nykyiset toimintatavat ja luomaan uutta yhdessä huippuasiantuntijoidemme kanssa. Jos haluat jättää kädenjälkesi siihen, miten modernia dataliiketoimintaa rakennetaan, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Netum on IT-palvelutalo, jolla on yli 20 vuoden kokemus vaativista IT-hankkeista. Autamme asiakkaitamme digitaalisen liiketoiminnan kehityksessä, toteuttamalla juuri heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivia ja kestäviä digiratkaisuja – viisaasti ja vastuullisesti.

Minkälaisesta tehtävästä on kyse?

Työssäsi Senior Data Engineerinä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisin teknologiakattauksin erityisesti Microsoftin kuin muidenkin teknologioiden parissa. Sinulla on jo useamman vuoden kokemus data-alustojen, tietovarastojen ja analytiikkaratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta. Hallitset SQL:n, tietomallinnuksen sekä Azure-pohjaiset datapalvelut, ja pystyt viemään ratkaisuja itsenäisesti suunnittelusta tuotantoon. Toimit asiakkaan luotettuna asiantuntijana, osallistut teknisten ratkaisujen määrittelyyn ja autat myös muita kehittymään osaamisessaan. Samalla haluat jatkuvasti syventää osaamistasi ja hyödyntää uusimpia datateknologioita asiakasratkaisuissa.

Tulet työskentelemään esimerkiksi näiden osa-alueiden parissa:

Microsoft Fabric -pohjaisten data- ja analytiikkaratkaisujen toteuttaminen ja vieminen tuotantoon, mukaan lukien Data Factory-, Lakehouse-, Warehouse- ja Power BI -komponenttien käyttäminen
ELT/ETL-dataputkien kehittäminen (esim. Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Synapse)
Tietoallasratkaisut esim. Lakehouse tai OneLake
Raportointiratkaisujen rakentaminen (Power BI tmv.)
Tietovarastokehityksen automaatio- ja kiihtymistyökalut esim. WhereScape, ADE tai D#
Data Vault 2.0 / 2.1-tietomallinnus
Datan käsittelykielet (esim. Python, R, Spark tai C#)

Lisäksi katsomme eduksesi kokemuksen esimerkiksi:

Microsoft Purviewista
Tekoälyä hyödyntävistä data- ja analytiikkaratkaisuista

Tärkeintä meille on tehtävässä viihtyminen sekä mielenkiintoisten urakokonaisuuksien luominen, joten tehtävää on mahdollista muovata oman kiinnostuksesi mukaisesti. Halutessasi tehtävään voi liittyä esimerkiksi projektinhallinnan tehtäviä tai mentorina toimimista nuoremmille tieteenharjoittajille.

Työotteeltasi olet ratkaisukeskeinen, näet haasteissa mahdollisuuksia ja haluat soveltaa osaamistasi aktiivisesti ratkaisujen löytämiseksi. Työtehtävässä onnistuminen edellyttää hyviä yhteistyötaitoja sekä sujuvaa suomen kielen osaamista.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Datayksikössämme pääset vahvistamaan osaamistasi ja rakentamaan ammatillista tulevaisuuttasi osana Netumin menestystarinaa. Projekteissamme pääset mukaan ainutlaatuisiin ja yhteiskunnallisesti merkittäviin projekteihin. Työskentelemme niin julkisen kuin yksityisen sektorin datan parissa. Työtehtävä tarjoaa sopivasti haasteita ja mielenkiintoisia kehittymismahdollisuuksia.

Meillä tekemisen keskiössä on mahdollisimman mielekäs arki ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa oman uransa suuntaan. Osaamisen kehittäminen on meille tärkeää ja tarjoammekin sinulle mahdollisuuden esimerkiksi erilaisten sertifikaattien suorittamiseen. Lisäksi työajastasi 6% on varattu oman osaamisen kehittämiselle.

Työpaikan sijainnin suhteen olemme joustavia. Voit työskennellä jollain toimipisteellämme Tampereella, Helsingissä, Turussa, Hämeenlinnassa, Jyväskylässä tai Oulussa, mutta työt onnistuvat myös kotikonttorilta käsin.

Työskentelysi tueksi saat modernit työvälineet ja lisäksi käytössäsi on kattavat työsuhde-edut kuten lounasetu, virkistysetu, työmatkaetu, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus sekä työkykyvakuutus. Järjestämme säännöllisin väliajoin myös mukavaa virkistystoimintaa ja kokoonnuumme koko porukan voimin myös muutaman kerran vuodessa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Mahtavaa! Jos mielenkiintosi heräsi, niin lähetäthän vapaamuotoisen hakemuksesi ja CV:si palkkatoiveineen oheisen linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja rekrytointiprosessista voit kysyä rekrytoijaltamme Julialta, julia.rasanen@netum.fi / +358 45 783 621 11.

jobs.title: (Senior) Power Apps & Web Application Developer (Dynamics 365 & Dataverse)
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Build the digital backbone that powers our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance teams

Do you want to be hands-on in building the platform that powers how we manage every investment, from lead through to exit? And are you ready to take technical ownership of a growing, business-critical application that combines low-code Power Apps with modern JavaScript/Node.js web development, used every day by our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance colleagues?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

A hands-on, technically deep role at the centre of our internal Investment Management application, spanning both Power Platform and custom web application development
Close collaboration with our Business Application Manager and external development resources, as part of a small, focused core development team
The opportunity to shape a platform still early in its journey — with a clear roadmap and real influence over how it evolves, including its growing web application layer

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting more than 25 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

The team:
A place where great ideas can come from anyone
Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

On this application specifically, you will work day-to-day alongside our Business Application Manager, who coordinates prioritisation and the release process, and a small pool of external developers who provide specialist and overflow capacity. Together, you form the core development team — working closely with Product Owners, Super Users, and functional subject-matter experts from Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to keep the backlog moving and the platform improving.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

You develop and evolve our internal investment management application

Our internal Investment Management application is built on Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, and the Dynamics 365 platform (using only capabilities that do not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence). It supports the full investment lifecycle — from lead and screening, through portfolio management and monitoring, to exit. Alongside this low-code foundation, an increasing share of the application is built as custom web applications — using JavaScript and Node.js — to deliver functionality that goes beyond what Power Apps supports out of the box.

We are looking for a Power Apps & Web Application Developer to take day-to-day technical ownership of the application's codebase and configuration and be the technical lead for the application and its growth over the coming years. You will work closely with our Business Application Manager and external developer resources as the core development team, turning a continuously prioritised backlog into reliable, well-built functionality for the business — spanning both the Power Platform and our custom web application components. You will take the lead on deciding when a requirement is best solved with low-code Power Apps versus custom web development, in dialogue with the Business Application Manager.

You will, for example:
Platform development:
design, build, and maintain Power Apps (model-driven and canvas) and Dataverse solution components — tables, relationships, business rules, and automation — that underpin the application
Web application development:
design, build, and maintain custom web applications and services using JavaScript and Node.js, extending the platform beyond native Power Apps capabilities and integrating tightly with Dataverse via APIs
Dynamics 365 configuration:
configure and extend Dynamics 365 platform capabilities used within the application, strictly limited to functionality that does not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence
Process automation:
build Power Automate flows that automate approvals, notifications, and data flows between the application, our ERP, and other enterprise systems
Backlog delivery:
work from the prioritised Kanban backlog together with the Business Application Manager, who owns the board and coordinates prioritisation and release
Requirements translation:
engage directly with super users and functional SMEs across Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to understand needs and translate them into technical designs
Collaboration with external resources:
coordinate day-to-day with external developers on shared backlog items, ensuring consistent quality, patterns, and documentation across the codebase
Testing and release:
support structured testing cycles and releases, working with super users to validate functionality before it reaches the wider organisation
Production support:
troubleshoot and resolve issues in the live application — both the Power Platform components and the custom web application layer — protecting data integrity and keeping the platform reliable for daily use
Documentation:
maintain clear technical documentation of the data model, configurations, and customisations to support governance and knowledge transfer

You bring hands-on Power Platform and web development skills, and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and modern web development, you become invested in turning business requirements from investment, risk, valuation, or finance stakeholders into robust, well-structured solutions.

We imagine that you:
Technical foundation:
have a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
Platform expertise:
have solid hands-on experience developing with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), and Power Automate
Web development skills:
have solid hands-on experience building web applications and services with JavaScript and Node.js, and are comfortable working across both front-end and back-end code
Dynamics 365 knowledge:
understand Dynamics 365 as a platform, including entity modelling, business rules, and security roles
Collaborative delivery:
are comfortable working from a shared, continuously prioritised backlog alongside a Business Application Manager and external developers
Communication:
communicate clearly with both technical colleagues and non-technical business stakeholders across departments
Problem-solving:
take a structured, hands-on approach to troubleshooting issues in a live, business-critical application
Have experience with plugin development (C#) or PCF component development on the Power Platform
Are familiar with Azure DevOps and ALM practices for Power Platform and web application deployment

Bonus points if you:
Have experience with modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries (such as React, Vue, or Express) for building web applications
Having domain knowledge from investment management, risk, valuation, or finance processes, is a plus
Have experience from the financial sector or an impact-focused organisation, is a plus

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve, with a growing web application layer alongside it. As Power Apps & Web Application Developer, you will work with:
Microsoft Dataverse (our core data platform for this application)
Microsoft Power Apps (model-driven and canvas apps)
Microsoft Power Automate
JavaScript and Node.js for custom web application and API development

Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O), as an integrated neighbouring system

What we offer

An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact
A focused, hands-on role with real ownership of a growing, business-critical platform

Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com)

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Spirii is looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer.

If you are passionate about cloud software development, team collaboration, and creating outstanding backend code, join Spirii's fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working, including how we adopt AI to raise the quality and speed of our engineering.

You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with CPH and near-shore colleagues, as well as Finance and partner teams.

What You Will Do

Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure backend services and cloud-native queue-based pipelines (Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript) that power data ingestion, processing, and invoice generation at high throughput.

Ambitious and execution-focused, with strong ability to balance functional and non-functional requirements when designing solutions.
A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex backend systems and actively maintaining operational awareness.

Comfortable working in Agile, cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, Finance, partners), and an active participant in creating an open, collaborative environment.
Excellent English communication skills and the ability to interact with all levels of the organization, internally and externally with partners/customers.

Qualifications

7+ years of professional software development experience.
Extensive hands-on experience designing and scaling production backend systems, including having designed event-driven, queue/job-based architectures.
Strong experience building TypeScript or JavaScript (Node.js, NestJS) microservices on cloud platforms such as AWS.
Experience leading design discussions, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical point of contact for a team or domain.

Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with the discipline needed for financially accurate, auditable data.
Experience integrating external and internal IT systems, and solid API design.
Experience with developing secure software is a plus.
Knowledge of Redis and NoSQL databases is an advantage.
Experience working with or integrating ERP systems (e.g. Microsoft Business Central) is an advantage.
Experience with billing, payments, invoicing, or other financial/transactional systems is a strong plus.
Hands-on experience using AI assistants and/or agentic workflows to improve engineering productivity is a plus.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its seven-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.
